# EMS & FIRE PRO

> Professional development and networking platform for emergency medical services and firefighting professionals through regional expos and conferences.

EMS & FIRE PRO organizes continuing education events and conferences across multiple U.S. regions, connecting first responders with training opportunities, industry networking, and professional development resources. The platform serves as a hub for EMS and fire service professionals to advance their careers and stay current with industry standards.

## Key Topics

- EMS & FIRE PRO Expo
- First Responders
- Continuing Education (CEU)
- Professional Development
- Networking Events
- Conference
- Expo Registration
- EMS-Fire Services
- Regional Events
- Professional Networking
- Training
- Alaska Region
- California Region

## Regional Events & Service Areas

- [Alaska First Responders: Join us at the EMS & FIRE PRO Expo!](https://emspro.org/service_areas/alaska): EMS & FIRE PRO Expo for Alaska first responders with training and networking opportunities
- [California | EMS & FIRE PRO Expo + Conference](https://emspro.org/service_areas/california): EMS & FIRE PRO Expo and Conference for California first responders
